dataset: FoodJatim resolved LLM-only silver temporal event knowledge graph v2

mapping_decisions.event_mentions: Each extracted source event is an fj:EventMention anchored to exactly one article.
mapping_decisions.bitemporal_events: Each event has an OWL-Time valid-time interval; source report timestamps remain separate on articles, mentions, evidence, assertions, and canonical first/last report properties.
mapping_decisions.publisher_provenance: Channel-specific source keys map to normalized publisher organizations and remain traceable from every source-derived graph item.
mapping_decisions.canonical_events: Only accepted cross-document clusters receive an fj:CanonicalEvent node; owl:sameAs is not used.
mapping_decisions.soft_event_resolution: Every accepted mention-to-canonical convenience edge has a reified EventResolutionAssertion with same-event probability, rationale, method, report time, publisher, and LLM-only provenance.
mapping_decisions.negative_coreference: Rejected event pairs are EventIdentityComparison nodes; they are not mislabeled as contradictory source claims.
mapping_decisions.corroboration: Direct source assertions co-supporting the same resolved relation receive confidence-bearing EvidenceAgreementAssertion nodes. independenceAssessed=false because syndication was not adjudicated.
mapping_decisions.contradiction: The ontology can represent explicit contradiction, but none is materialized because the current positive-only silver annotations contain no contradiction judgment.
mapping_decisions.resolved_relations: Relations touching a canonical event are materialized with aggregated evidence-bearing assertions.
mapping_decisions.cross_document_relations: Each cross-document respondsTo edge is entailed from a direct assertion and a separately represented event-coreference premise.
mapping_decisions.citesPolicy: Bare citations remain NewsArticle-to-PolicyInstrument edges and are not duplicated as canonical event edges.
